forum.title: Missing "Multi-library support" in NanoEdge AI Studio v5.1.0
forum.best_answer_content:
Hi @Lynora,

We are going to support it in the next major release.

In the meantime, please look at this workaround:

[NanoEdge AI Studio 5.1.0 multi library - STMicroelectronics Community](https://community.st.com/t5/tkb/workflowpage/tkb-id/stm32-mcus-knowledge-base/article-id/1914)

Have a good day,

Julian
forum.content_text: I was previously using **version 5.0.2**, where I could enable the **'Multi-library'** option in the **Deployment** step (Step 5). After updating to **v5.1.0**, I can no longer find this checkbox. Since I need to deploy two separate libraries in my project, what is the recommended workflow now?
forum.author: Lynora
